title: drawtonomy planning trace v1
description: What one actor drove in a run and what its planner intended at every replanning cycle. The prose specification is docs/planning-trace-format.md; this file is the shape both the writer's self-check and drawtonomy's fixture tests validate against. v1 is additive: unknown fields are allowed everywhere, so a new optional field never breaks a reader.

schema.description: Exactly this string. Any other value is refused, naming the supported schema.

frame.description: What the positions mean: the body centre, or the reference point (rear axle centre).

scenario.description: Scenario identifier this trace was computed for.

scenarioFingerprint.description: The scenario XML the planner ran on. Same value, same normalization, as a checker verdict's field of the same name.

solutionFingerprint.description: The solution XML this trace's driven states reproduce. Written only when the writer's self-check proved they do, so a verdict of the same solution verifies against this trace.

producer.description: Free-form; { name, version } by convention. Informational only.

tracks.description: One entry per actor, at least one.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the file's UTF-8 text, without one leading BOM and with LF line endings, as 'sha256:' + 64 lowercase hex.

state.description: One state. Metres and radians; t is seconds from the start of the scenario.

candidate.description: One trajectory the planner evaluated in this cycle. Only `states` is required: a planner that scores everything writes `cost`, one that rejects trajectories writes `feasible` and `reason`.

cost.description: The planner's own score for this candidate. One number; its scale is the planner's business and is not compared across producers.

feasible.description: False when the planner rejected this candidate. Absent means feasible.

reason.description: Why it was rejected, free text. Recommended words: infeasible_kinematic, infeasible_collision, infeasible_rule.

plan.description: What the planner intended at one replanning cycle.

t.description: When the plan was issued [s]. Equals states[0].t.

candidates.description: The trajectories evaluated in this cycle and not executed. Drawn as a fan; colour follows array order.

vehicle.description: The body the planner planned with. A CommonRoad planning problem carries no ego shape, so without this the app falls back to the size the actor was drawn with.

refToCenter.description: Reference point (rear axle centre) to body centre along the heading [m].

track.description: One actor. Exactly one of `role` / `name` says which actor it is.

role.description: Matches the actor marked as ego in the scene.

name.description: Matches an actor by entity name.

driven.description: The states this actor actually drove.
